h1: Rank #1 as a contractor: Industry-Specific SEO That Converts
intro: Marketing a contractor is nothing like marketing a generic local business. Your clients research carefully, compare options, and trust signals matter more than slogans. Licensed, bonded, and insured claims are baseline trust signals every page needs. Project galleries with budgets and timelines prove reliability better than promises. Trade-specific pages for remodeling or roofing capture higher-intent searches. Review responses showing professionalism influence prospects researching multiple bidders. With industry-specific SEO, your contractor can own the searches that matter instead of fighting for scraps. Local SEO is a long game, but every month of consistent work compounds: better rankings bring more calls, more calls bring more reviews, and more reviews push rankings higher still. Businesses that commit to the process pull away from competitors that dabble.
